verdict.rationale: Docs mention that agents 'use their own computers' to build/test/demo features and can run in parallel 'fleets' (cursor-docs-8, cursor-docs-12), implying some isolated execution environment, and MCP tool calls require approval by default (cursor-docs-21). However, there is no explicit documentation of a true sandbox model (network restrictions, filesystem isolation policy, permission model) that an engineering-lead could configure or audit. Missing for 10: explicit sandbox architecture docs, network/filesystem isolation guarantees, admin controls over sandbox scope, and independent verification of isolation behavior.
